versions.content: If a Trigger is mapped to multiple ISignal s which refer to DataTransformation s and if those DataTransformation s refer to the same TransformationTechnology s at the beginning of the ordered transformer- Chain and no XfrmVariableDataPrototypeInstanceRef is specified for that TransformationTechnology and no ComBasedTransformer is included in the transformer chains, the execution should be optimized.
